title: Urdais Photonics — PH-3 research close-out
status: formal close-out record; internal research artifact; not routed publicly; not registered in the docs catalog
implements_nothing: no production code, migration, ingestion, schema, frontend change or ontology build; no price data fabricated; nothing committed

final_status.client_optics_status: DEFERRED — intended home of UPPI; economic object defined, comparison key frozen, no source cleared
final_status.coherent_dci_status: DEFERRED — separate family; cleanest object and best cadence; Dell'Oro documented but terms unread; single-provider dependency
final_status.next_action: NONE FOR PHOTONICS — proceed to the Power Index. One open recommendation requiring separate authorisation: remove the UPPI demo from the public frontend.
final_status.primary_blocker: a written derived-publication right, not data availability, not methodology, not cost
final_status.secondary_blocker: merchant path only: no legitimate historical backfill at 12/24/36 months, and retiming_architecture frequently absent from listing text

preservation_note: ph-1-uppi-benchmark-methodology.md existed only in a session scratchpad and was copied into docs/research/photonics/ during this close-out; it would otherwise have been lost

positions.PH-2A: read in full; prohibit scraping and derivative publication

artifact_disagreements_resolved.principle: a failed fetch is not evidence that no terms exist

positions.PH-2B probe: no merchant served a public price to a non-browser client
positions.PH-2A: fetched real prices from CDW and Vitex

artifact_disagreements_resolved.principle: the blocker is the licence, not availability

positions.PH-2B: VIABLE — specification facts are not copyrightable
positions.PH-2A: AMBIGUOUS_REQUIRES_LEGAL_REVIEW for a commercial database of IEEE-extracted facts

artifact_disagreements_resolved.principle: the more conservative and better-evidenced position; neither pass read IEEE GET Terms and Conditions

artifact_disagreements_resolved.resolution: PH-3 lettering is canonical; crosswalk recorded
a single-report sticker price; not an access licence, not a historical-file price, and not a publication right

settled_findings: rate alone is not a product identity — eight distinct optical PMDs exist at 800 Gb/s in one IEEE standard
no daily or weekly optical-transceiver price market exists; interpolation into daily values is prohibited
client/datacom optics and coherent DCI are different economic markets
product ontology and economic observation are separate layers; replacing a price provider must not change what a product is
public macro proxies (communications-equipment PPI, residual customs unit values) are context, never UPPI
merchant pricing is not cleared: terms read at FS.com and DigiKey prohibit the required behaviour; other merchants unread (UNKNOWN, not blocked); no merchant history exists
commercial ASP data exists at adequate grain but publication rights do not
licensed weights do not route around the rights problem; no weights-only licence is documented anywhere

economic_object.uppi_is_intended_to_measure: the change over time in the price of a precisely specified optical connectivity capability, holding that capability constant
uppi_is_not_intended_to_measure: the total cost of building a network
the cost of optical bandwidth per bit
the price of 'optics' as an undifferentiated category

rejected_objects_and_why.shipment_weighted_ASP: a market statistic, not a price index; PH-1 stress tests showed it printing +11% and +20% while every constituent price fell, and -19.7% on a pure reach-mix shift with no price change; also the least reproducible
rejected_objects_and_why.cost_per_optical_bandwidth: a hedonic with the bandwidth coefficient silently forced to 1.0; mechanically manufactures a ~50% decline at each generational doubling
rejected_objects_and_why.reference_cluster_cost: a valid but different object — a cost index that deliberately mixes price and architecture; preserved separately as candidate G
rejected_objects_and_why.channel_acquisition_pricing: the likely observation basis, not the economic object

economic_object.naming_discipline: if built on channel or listed prices, the published identifier must say so, mirroring the existing UCPI-H100-SXM-LISTED precedent; never presented or named as industry ASP or market price

Photonics.client_datacom_optics: intended home of UPPI; leaves are specification-aware series, never nominal rates
Photonics.coherent_dci: SEPARATE family, never a sub-series of client optics

structure.candidate_G: reference-fabric BOM is a cost index and sits beside both families, never inside either

structural_rules: the client/DCI split is at the top of the tree and is the first field evaluated; it must not be possible to place an 800ZR series under the client family by configuration
the leaf is a specification-aware series; '800G' is a navigation label at most, never an instrument
a cost index is never blended with or presented as a price index

comparison_key.purpose: prevent a future engineer from returning to rate=800G, price=X as the whole product definition

REQUIRED_FOR_PRICE_IDENTITY.note: evaluated first; gates every other comparison
composite field — encodes reach, fiber type, wavelength plan and lane count in one canonical token
partly implied by PMD; retained because draft/vendor-defined names do not reliably encode it and twin-port modules break the implication. RULE: where rate and PMD conflict, PMD wins
genuinely separates products, but listings frequently state neither LPO nor retimed; must be resolved from the manufacturer part number, never inferred from absence of a label
6-8x observed price spread on the same PMD
twin-port OSFP presents 2x400 Gb/s; module rate, endpoint rate and port count are three different numbers

ATTRIBUTE_ONLY.note: REFINED from PH-2B, which called it a required disambiguator. Two modules differing only in ratification status are the same product with different provenance. Mandatory to record
MPO-12 vs MPO-16 APC varies within one PMD; split on it only if observed prices separate
the observation identifier for matched-model linking
EOL clearance is a known outlier source
a revision mismatch is not a different PMD

UNRESOLVED.issue: required for identity but not reliably observable from public listing text; a resolution method is a reopening gate

evidence.oem: Cisco OSFP-800G-DR8= at CDW — USD 10791.78 list / USD 7464.99 advertised; a lower sign-in price exists
evidence.compatible: approximately USD 900-1250; Vitex 800G QSFP-DD DR8 at USD 1100 in stock
evidence.spread: roughly six- to eight-fold on the same PMD

policy: commercial_coding is a price-identity field, not an attribute
OEM and compatible are separate strata and are NEVER averaged, under any weighting, for any reason
they are different goods, not different prices for one good — warranty, qualified firmware, support entitlement and switch-vendor lock-in differ; the spread is not a discount
neither universe is preferred by this close-out; the choice requires the SKU census
whichever is chosen, the published series must name it
an observation whose coding cannot be determined is dropped, not defaulted

candidate_dispositions.name: Specification-matched merchant price index
candidate_dispositions.economic_object: constant-quality price change of a specified optical capability, observed from channel offers
candidate_dispositions.reason: methodologically sound and maximally reproducible; blocked by contract at both catalogues whose terms were read (FS.com, DigiKey), each prohibiting the collection method AND derivative publication; Optcore bars Urdais's crawler class by name
unresolved_blockers: no legitimate historical backfill at 12/24/36 months
retiming_architecture not derivable from listing text
terms unread at CDW, Vitex, FiberMall, LINK-PP, Mouser, Arrow, Avnet — UNKNOWN, not blocked
candidate_dispositions.reopening_evidence: written consent from one merchant, OR a terms review establishing an unbarred one; plus SKU census, repeat-observation pilot, cross-merchant dispersion, and a demonstrated retiming-resolution method

candidate_dispositions.name: Licensed specification-level professional ASP
candidate_dispositions.economic_object: shipment-weighted industry ASP within a specification category
candidate_dispositions.reason: LightCounting is the only source whose public abstract puts pricing on a rate x reach x form-factor x architecture grid, and forbids redistribution without expressed permission; Cignal forbids derivative works and documents no ASP field; Omdia grain and rights unresolved; Dell'Oro measures optical transport
unresolved_blockers: whether any provider separates DR8 from 2xFR4 from LPO
candidate_dispositions.reopening_evidence: the seventeen Omdia answers, or equivalents from another provider, critically including written derived-publication rights
candidate_dispositions.note: best historical depth of any candidate (LightCounting actuals 2022-2025) and worst reproducibility (a modelled ASP cannot be audited by a third party)

candidate_dispositions.name: Client-optics cost / bandwidth index
candidate_dispositions.economic_object: the cost of client optical bandwidth inside the data centre, in index form
candidate_dispositions.reason: weight-bearing by construction; inherits BOTH A's collection blocker and B's licensing blocker
unresolved_blockers: a published treatment of breakout double-counting
candidate_dispositions.reopening_evidence: A unblocked AND weights at key grain — or a decision to build G instead

candidate_dispositions.name: Hybrid permitted prices + licensed weights
candidate_dispositions.economic_object: self-observed specification-level prices aggregated with provider shipment weights
candidate_dispositions.reason: mathematically ordinary (a Lowe/Laspeyres construction) and asks a provider for less than B does, but does NOT escape the rights problem: no weights-only licence is documented, and an index whose weights come from a provider's unit file is a derivative of that data even if no provider number is displayed
unresolved_blockers: a weights-only licence that does not publicly exist
weight reconstruction: published sub-indices plus a published aggregate make the weight vector algebraically solvable — with monthly cadence and eight strata, within roughly eight months
candidate_dispositions.reopening_evidence: a contract granting, in substance, publication of an index whose weights are computed from the provider's unit file without displaying units, shares or ASP, including via API, for the life of the index, including after termination, with stated attribution; plus an agreed reconstruction mitigation; plus a weight-lag sensitivity test

candidate_dispositions.name: Coherent DCI pricing
candidate_dispositions.economic_object: price of pluggable coherent optics for data-centre interconnect (400ZR, 400ZR+, 800ZR, 800ZR+)
candidate_dispositions.reason: cleanest economic object and best cadence in the investigation, with the clearest provider fit (Dell'Oro ASP by speed for ZR/ZR+ plugs); blocked on unread contract terms and an unresolved ZR-vs-ZR+ split
unresolved_blockers: ZR vs ZR+ as separate ASP rows
whether host coherent-software licences sit inside or outside the module ASP
candidate_dispositions.reopening_evidence: Dell'Oro terms read; grain confirmed; documented position on single-source risk; a quote
candidate_dispositions.note: most likely to be unblocked by a single conversation, and least source-redundant if it is

candidate_dispositions.name: Public government validation / context series
candidate_dispositions.reason: BLS PCU33423342 and HTS 8517.62.00.90 have the cleanest rights in the vertical — free, attribution-only — and measure an industry and a residual customs basket respectively; useful as a negative control and context panel
binding_display_constraints: index points only, never a dollar level
basket definition carried in the series name, not a footnote
never routed under a UPPI identifier
methodology text must forbid multiplication by an assumed base dollar

candidate_dispositions.name: Reference-fabric optical BOM / UPPI-CONNECT
candidate_dispositions.economic_object: cost of the optical bill of materials for one published, versioned reference AI fabric, in $ per GPU and $ per delivered Tbps
candidate_dispositions.reason: most differentiated idea produced by the investigation and the ONLY candidate with no licensed-data dependency (the reference topology supplies the quantities every other design must license as weights); blocked because it consumes candidate A's price observations
unresolved_blockers: a reference topology derivable from citable public engineering documents rather than invented — an unproven condition
candidate_dispositions.reopening_evidence: A unblocked, plus a defensible published topology
candidate_dispositions.note: a COST index that deliberately mixes price and architecture; must never be blended with or presented as a constant-quality price index; a topology version change is a methodology event, never a silent edit

ontology.reason_not_to_build: its only consumer is a deferred product; no compelling reason independent of UPPI

rights_by_document_family.detail: copying permitted, and derivative works that comment on or explain the IA may be prepared, published and distributed, if the copyright notice is kept and the document is not modified
authorized to download, reproduce and distribute; all other rights reserved; no patent licence
licence to download, reproduce and distribute under the OSFP MSA Agreement; no other IP licence

GET provides the standard at no cost — a right to OBTAIN it. Whether a commercial database of extracted facts is permitted was not established; GET Terms and Conditions were not read. Verbatim clause text is IEEE copyright and must never be copied into Urdais
announcement is public; the specification's own reuse notice was not read. Do not assume the QSFP-DD sentence applies
use as evidence of what is sold; the ontology key must be the standard name, never the vendor part number

future_implementation_owns: canonical product identity — the seven price-identity fields with closed vocabularies
standards references — body, document identifier, revision, PMD name as the body spells it
revision/version — document revision stored, never collapsed; earlier revisions remain valid keys
draft/final status — recorded as provenance; a draft-referenced key is marked, never promoted silently

provider mappings — a versioned per-provider concordance onto pmd_designation, never by renaming Urdais's canonical terms; where a provider's category is only '800G' the mapping fails and that provider cannot feed that instrument, which is a data defect and not a reason to coarsen the key
manufacturer/SKU mappings — MPN to canonical key as an attribute layer
provenance — source document, revision, retrieval date and evidence class for every fact

rights_package_required.governing_distinction: an ACCESS LICENCE lets Urdais read the data; a DERIVED PUBLICATION / REDISTRIBUTION LICENCE lets Urdais publish something computed from it. These are two separate purchases. Every provider examined sells the first; none publicly offers the second. Internal viewing must never be upgraded by assumption into storage, display, an index, an API, or retention.

required_grants.note: often assumed covered by (4); it is not — ask separately
not contemplated by any standard media clause; must be named explicitly
determines whether a lapsed contract forces withdrawal of published history

additional_terms: whether weights alone can be licensed without licensing or displaying ASP
what happens to the derived index on a provider category restatement — chain link, series break, or withdrawal
whether the grant is perpetual for already-published values or coterminous with the subscription
the price of the publication licence separately from access
whether a licensed relationship unblocks Urdais's crawler class, currently barred at / by LightCounting and Omdia

omdia_reopening_questions.gating_note: if the atomic priced category is nominal rate, the dataset cannot support a specification-aware index and questions 9-17 do not matter. Ask it first.

questions.q: exact pricing grain — what is the atomic priced category?
are PMD, reach, form factor and retiming architecture distinguishable? Are 800GBASE-DR8, 2x400GBASE-FR4, 800GBASE-VR8 and 800G-DR8-LPO separate ASP rows?
definition of ASP — vendor revenue divided by units, a modelled price, or a blend? What share is estimated?
questions.reopening_answer: a stated construction with a stated estimated share

questions.q: historical actual coverage — first period Omdia will stand behind per AI-relevant row
actual vs forecast flags — how is the boundary marked in the file?
update cadence of the price (not the PDF) and lag after period end
revision policy — what the November 2024 telecom pricing correction did to previously delivered history
units / revenue / ASP alignment on the same row at the same grain

parallel_targets.LightCounting: same questions substituting their 'pricing' field; plus the process for obtaining the expressed permission their own clause names
parallel_targets.Cignal AI: first ask whether a price field exists at all, and what the Citation Policy permits
parallel_targets.Dell'Oro: rights questions for ZR/ZR+ only; plus whether client Ethernet modules are excluded by construction

omdia_reopening_questions.good_faith_item: Urdais's crawler class is barred at / in both LightCounting's and Omdia's robots.txt; Urdais has honoured that and collected nothing. Say so unprompted.

natural_source_cadence.merchant_offers: monthly at best, irregular and sticky

rules: the index publishes at its source's cadence and no faster
three distinct dates: observation, period described, publication — never conflated
stale series are marked stale; holding the last value flat is permitted only if labelled 'last observed' and the API returns the real observation date
inception date published prominently; a series begins when observation began
missing periods are represented as missing — never interpolated, never forward-filled into the stored series
raw observations are append-only; a correction supersedes rather than edits; index releases carry a release vintage
different inception dates across technologies are expected and correct — a 1.6T series does not need fake history to align visually with 400G; charts must tolerate ragged left edges
the surface exposes only change windows the observations support; a quarterly series has no 1D or 1W change and those elements must be ABSENT, not rendered as 'N/A'
hard cut at the last actual period; forecast rows must be structurally incapable of entering a published index

prototype_disposition.requires: separate authorisation and its own change; PH-3 does not modify the frontend
prototype_disposition.current_state: UPPI with five rate-only instruments (100G/200G/400G/800G/1.6T), unit $/transceiver, 800G headline, entirely synthetic demo data, 1D/1W changes and a 7-day intraday series generated from seeds
reasoning: the taxonomy is known to be wrong, not merely provisional — rate-only instruments are settled finding 1's exact failure
the most prominent numbers (today's change) are the least defensible — generator artefacts for a market with no daily price
UPPI is not required for the MVP; there is no product cost to removal
the credibility risk is to the live products — a demo sitting beside UCPI, UTVI, UMPI, GBV and Power Delivery, distinguishable only by a label, transfers doubt onto the real ones
a research label mitigates uncertainty, not known incorrectness
prototype_disposition.acceptable_second_choice: KEEP_AS_INTERNAL_DEMO_ONLY, if there is a UI-development reason to retain a multi-instrument market for layout work, provided it is unreachable from public routes
prototype_disposition.if_removal_proceeds: also retire the rate-only instrument definitions rather than leave them dormant, so a future engineer starts from the comparison key rather than from the prototype's five rates

reopen_triggers.name: Commercial dataset with written derived-publication rights at acceptable cost
reopen_triggers.fires_when: a provider supplies, in writing, the required rights package (or a sufficient defined subset) at a quoted price Urdais accepts
verify_before_reopening: pricing grain finer than nominal rate, separating PMD / reach / form factor / retiming architecture
rights 3-10 granted in writing, with API and MCP named explicitly
post-termination retention of published history granted
actual/forecast boundary flagged at row level
revision policy documented
units, revenue and ASP aligned on the same row at the same grain
access price and publication-licence price quoted separately

reopen_triggers.name: Rights-cleared merchant or API source with adequate specification grain
reopen_triggers.fires_when: a merchant or catalogue grants, in writing, automated collection plus derived publication — OR a terms review establishes a price-publishing merchant whose terms bar neither
verify_before_reopening: written consent, or a terms page read in full permitting both behaviours
SKU census demonstrating the strata can be populated
a demonstrated method for resolving retiming_architecture where listings are silent
cross-merchant dispersion measured on identical specifications
SKU identifier stability confirmed across at least one pilot window
explicit OEM/compatible separation available in the source data

reopen_triggers.name: New public or open dataset directly measuring optical pricing
reopen_triggers.fires_when: a statistical agency, standards body, exchange or open-data programme publishes a series whose OBJECT is optical transceiver prices at specification grain
verify_before_reopening: the series measures transceivers, not an industry aggregate or a residual customs basket
grain reaches at least PMD level
licence permits derived publication
cadence and revision policy documented
reopen_triggers.does_not_fire_on: a new communications-equipment PPI, a new customs code, or a broader HS breakout, unless it isolates pluggable optical modules by PMD

reopen_triggers.name: Sufficient prospective rights-cleared observations accumulate
reopen_triggers.fires_when: a rights-cleared collection from trigger B has run long enough to support a matched-model index
verify_before_reopening: minimum observation count per stratum met, with the floor derived from measured dispersion rather than asserted
repeat observations across at least two chain-link candidate periods
outlier and lifecycle policy defined and tested against real data
measured list-price volatility supports the intended publication cadence

reopen_triggers.name: Commercial partnership supplying both data and publication rights
reopen_triggers.fires_when: a provider proposes a co-branded, attributed or partnership structure covering data and publication together
verify_before_reopening: all of trigger A's verification list
whether attribution or co-branding constrains Urdais's methodological independence
whether the structure creates a single-provider dependency (acute for candidate E)
what happens to the index if the partnership ends

anti_triggers: a new prototype, mockup or design asking for a photonics chart
competitor launch of a photonics index
a conference announcement, vendor roadmap or press claim about optical pricing
availability of a dataset whose rights are 'probably fine' or 'not explicitly prohibited'
a desire to increase the number of Urdais products

ph4.statement: PH-4 SHOULD NOT BEGIN. Price implementation is deferred. There is no PH-4 implementation phase and one must not be created because earlier planning assumed a phase count. The next Photonics work item is whichever reopen trigger fires first, and its first step is that trigger's verification list — not a new research phase.

stop_condition: PH-3 ends here, and with it the Photonics investigation for MVP purposes. No methodology selected, no production code, migration, ingestion, schema or frontend change, no ontology built, no price data fabricated, no PH-4 plan, nothing committed.
